LanguageData.LP_ChainDevil.label: chain devil
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevil.description: A devil wrapped all over in hooked chains that lash out on their own like living things. Chain devils are the jailers of the infernal legion: they can yank someone 4 cells away to their side with a chain, and can turn a lich's skeletons from a few steps away.
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevil.descriptionShort: Infernal jailer. Chain lash + pull, turns skeletons; banished to the Nine Hells when downed.
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevil.label: bone devil
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevil.description: A bone-white, gaunt, skin-and-bones devil with a scorpion-like tail curling up behind it. Bone devils are the overseers of the Nine Hells: the venom of their tail stinger numbs hands and feet, and people seeing one for the first time often go weak at the knees.
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevil.descriptionShort: Infernal overseer. Scorpion tail stinger (Constitution save difficulty 14, base success 45%), fear aura; banished to the Nine Hells when downed.
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevil.label: horned devil
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevil.description: A bat-winged, big-horned, scale-armored devil, the heavy infantry of the infernal legion. Horned devils can hurl a ball of hellfire 10 cells away.
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevil.descriptionShort: Infernal heavy infantry. Hellfire throw; banished to the Nine Hells when downed.
LanguageData.LP_Erinyes.label: erinyes
LanguageData.LP_Erinyes.description: Black-winged avengers, hunters the Nine Hells send after those in breach of contract. Erinyes look like tall humans, with red-black patterns crawling over their skin; they never fear and never let go of prey they've marked. A pact with Asmodeus can make an erinyes follow the signer for life; a deva's patient persuasion can bring her back to the heavens.
LanguageData.LP_Erinyes.descriptionShort: Playable infernal avenger. Hunt (marked target +15%), binding rope, fear immunity, Shooting / Melee talent +2; bound ones never break free.
LanguageData.LP_Amnizu.label: amnizu
LanguageData.LP_Amnizu.description: A shriveled, bald devil lawyer with a pair of small horns, leader of the infernal brokers. Whoever dares attack an amnizu, it touches a finger to their forehead, and they suddenly forget what they're best at.
LanguageData.LP_Amnizu.descriptionShort: Infernal lawyer. When attacked, the attacker makes an Intelligence save at difficulty 16 (base success 35%) or loses 2 levels in their best skill (1 day); banished to the Nine Hells when downed.
LanguageData.LP_Satyr.label: satyr
LanguageData.LP_Satyr.description: Fey descendants with goat horns, furry legs and hooves, born musicians and drinkers. Satyr blood is mortal blood and is inheritable; they have a natural resistance to magic, can knock people over with a charge, and are always the happiest at a party.
LanguageData.LP_Satyr.descriptionShort: Playable, inheritable. Psychic sensitivity ×0.6, mental save success +10%, ram, party mood +10, Artistic talent +2; can't wear shoes.
LanguageData.LP_Dryad.label: dryad
LanguageData.LP_Dryad.description: A fey bound to a tree, with bark patterns on the skin and hair the green of new leaves. Dryads can walk from one tree into another; but they can't leave their own tree: going too far makes them wither, and if the tree dies they won't survive a day themselves. Dryads are ageless and sterile; when sent by Titania they join as bound ones, with obedience that never drops.
LanguageData.LP_Dryad.descriptionShort: Playable fey. Tree bond (weakened beyond 40 cells from the tree, must bind a new tree within 24 hours after it dies), tree stride, Plants / Animals talent +4, sharp armor +15%, fears fire.
LanguageData.LP_Redcap.label: redcap
LanguageData.LP_Redcap.description: A small, savage fey wearing a cap dyed red with its victims' blood and heavy iron boots. Redcaps get fiercer the longer they fight: each hit makes them more vicious, and anyone lying on the ground gets stomped hard by their iron boots.
LanguageData.LP_Redcap.descriptionShort: Fey killer. Bloodlust (melee hits stack damage, up to +15), heavy stomp (×1.5 against downed targets); banished when downed.
LanguageData.LP_Changeling.label: changeling
LanguageData.LP_Changeling.description: A child swapped into a cradle by the fey, who even grown up can't forget where they came from. Changelings have skin pale without a hint of color and features like an unfinished sketch, but they can take the appearance of anyone they've seen. The bloodline is inheritable.
LanguageData.LP_Changeling.descriptionShort: Playable, inheritable. Thousand faces (copy someone's appearance for 24 hours), beauty has no effect, social talent +2; must be themself for 1 day every 30 days.
LanguageData.LP_WildHunter.label: wild hunt rider
LanguageData.LP_WildHunter.description: Fey hunters in antlered helms; both the winter court and the summer court keep a troop. The wild hunt chases only one prey: only those in the way get hit. Fey lances are especially deadly to the prey; like all fey, they fear cold iron.
LanguageData.LP_WildHunter.descriptionShort: Wild hunt rider (enemy only). Fey lance, +30% damage against the prey, fears cold iron; banished when downed, drops cold iron and a horn.
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntLord.label: wild hunt leader
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntLord.description: The leader of the wild hunt, with bigger antlers and a cloak of winter wolf pelt. Defeating it gives the true name of the agent of the patron it serves.
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntLord.descriptionShort: Wild hunt leader (enemy only). Drops the true name scroll of the patron's agent when defeated.
LanguageData.LP_Deva.label: deva
LanguageData.LP_Deva.description: An angel with platinum wings, an emissary sent to the mortal world by the good gods. Devas wield radiant maces and can close wounds with a touch; no invisibility or disguise escapes their eyes. Devas can persuade fallen erinyes to turn back, yet may also slowly fall themselves in the presence of the Abyss.
LanguageData.LP_Deva.descriptionShort: Celestial emissary. Radiant mace, healing touch (3 per day), truesight (sees through invisibility / disguises), ×1.5 damage against demons / devils / undead, immune to taint.
LanguageData.LP_Planetar.label: planetar
LanguageData.LP_Planetar.description: An angel twice the size of an ordinary person, with silver wings and a greatsword. Planetars are the war leaders of the good gods: celestial wrath rains radiance within 8 cells, and dispel can drive an outsider back to its plane. She has two legendary resistances.
LanguageData.LP_Planetar.descriptionShort: Celestial war leader (legendary tier: resistance 2, CR 16, level 18). Greatsword, celestial wrath, dispel; ×1.5 damage against demons / devils / undead.
